about.title: About
about.subtitle: Who I am
about.bio_1: Automation systems engineer and developer focused on backend, cybersecurity and industrial systems.
about.bio_2: I build tools that work in the real world — from scripts communicating with PLCs, through network scanners, to web applications. I prefer code that is simple, readable and does exactly what it should.
about.bio_3: Currently developing in the direction of industrial system security (OT/ICS security) and backend application architecture.
about.approach: I prefer to understand the system from the ground up before writing code. Documentation, tests and a clean interface are not options — they are requirements.
